tagline: Advancing exploration of one of North America's largest undeveloped gold resources in Alaska
hero_kpi_rationale: A discovery cost below $5.00/oz is a key value indicator in gold exploration, reflecting exceptional efficiency and sustainable competitive advantage.

kpis.name: Discovery Cost (gold)

kpis.description: A very low discovery cost strengthens the future economic viability of the project.
kpis.signal: Wow: <$5.00/oz is exceptional in gold exploration.

kpis.name: Total gold resource
kpis.explanation: Total quantity of gold estimated in the ground, in ounces.
kpis.description: The gold resource increases with each drilling campaign.

kpis.name: Average grade (gold)
kpis.explanation: Average concentration of gold in the resource, in grams per tonne.
kpis.description: A grade of 1.04 g/t is competitive for a bulk tonnage style project.
kpis.signal: High grade for a large-scale project.

risks.title: Mineral resources not converted to mineral reserves
risks.score_rationale: Risk positioned early in technical section (pages 8-9) with strong language ('no certainty', 'too speculative'). Trend stable but fundamental to the project. Industry category moderately weighted but critical to economic viability.

risks.title: Gold price volatility and market conditions
risks.score_rationale: Risk explicitly cited mid-report ('changes in the price of mineral market conditions') with material impact language ('could differ materially'). Trend stable but fundamental to project economics. Macro category heavily weighted.

risks.title: Mineral exploration risks and geological uncertainty
risks.score_rationale: Risk explicitly stated ('risks inherent in mineral exploration') mid-report with material impact language. Trend stable but inherent to exploration stage. Industry category moderately weighted.

risks.title: Access to additional capital and future funding
risks.score_rationale: Risk explicitly cited ('uncertainty of access to additional capital') mid-report. Trend mitigated (CAD $50M financing completed January 2026 with 20+ institutions). Capital category heavily weighted but current situation favorable.

risks.title: Development, construction and mining operation risks
risks.score_rationale: Risk explicitly stated ('risks associated with development, construction and mining operations') mid-report with material impact language. Trend stable, project in pre-feasibility study phase. Industry category moderately weighted.

risks.title: Uncertainty regarding future project profitability
risks.score_rationale: Risk explicitly cited ('uncertainty of future profitability') mid-report. Trend stable, project in pre-feasibility phase without proven reserves. Macro category heavily weighted for economic viability.

ai_positioning.summary: Freegold Ventures Limited does not employ any artificial intelligence technology in its mineral exploration or mining development operations according to available documents.
evidence: No mention of AI or machine learning in reports
